description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the KpiAPI within the OrangeHRM Performance Plugin. It defines a test suite for the KPI API endpoints including create, update, retrieve (all and one), and delete operations, using mock services and fixtures.

classes.name: KpiAPITest
classes.description: Test class for the KpiAPI endpoints within the OrangeHRM Performance Plugin, focusing on KPI operations.

methods.description: Test method for creating a KPI via API.
